therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of estrogen receptor-driven tumor cell proliferation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Women with locally advanced or metastatic estrogen receptor-positive, HER2 negative breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) assessed by RECIST 1.1

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in AUC and Cmax up to 450 mg, with accumulation ratios indicating steady-state achievement
biomarker_changes: Increased endometrial thickness at Week 12 (+4.079 mm) and Week 36 (+5.400 mm)
Increased uterine volume at Week 12 (+66.822 mL) and Week 36 (+41.083 mL)
Changes in bone turnover markers: BSAP increased (+5.912 U/L), PINP increased (+26.242 mcg/L), CTX increased (+0.047 ng/mL) at 450 mg
safety_signals: Dose-limiting toxicities observed at 600 mg (2/5 participants)
Most common serious adverse events: atrial fibrillation (3/115), cardiac events
Treatment-emergent adverse events in 115/115 participants at 450 mg
results.dose_information: 450 mg once daily oral capsules identified as recommended Phase 2 dose; doses tested: 100, 200, 300, 450, 600 mg

context.duration: Up to 33 months treatment, up to 63 months overall survival follow-up
